snapshot.text: Togo is rolling out universal health insurance (AMU), managed by the national health insurance institute and social security fund, with smart cards and a unified digital platform. It invests more in health than its neighbours, according to a 2026 comparison.

priorities.title: Universal health insurance
priorities.text: An AMU smart card was launched, with campaigns against fraud and talks on complementary cover.

priorities.title: Primary health care
priorities.text: The government reports progress in primary health care and better quality of care.

priorities.title: Private sector partnership
priorities.text: The state is betting on partnership with the private health sector.
